ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The soil food-web diagram shows a box labeled “Plant-feeding Nematodes” near the upper left-center. It is connected in the food web by arrows, and the predator section on the right includes boxes such as “Predatory Nematodes,” “Predatory Mites,” and “High level Predators.” Reasoning: The arrows indicate the food/resource pointing toward the organism that feeds on it, as shown by shoots/roots pointing to plant-feeding nematodes. Following the feeding arrow from “Plant-feeding Nematodes” to the predator section leads to the box labeled “Predatory Mites.”
